info.title: td serve remote-store facade API
info.description: Proposed td serve facade when using td-backend. Preserves td-gui /v1 routes and envelopes. serve selects saved project, registers web session, creates per-request idempotency keys, and loads revisions before mutations. Browser If-Match is optional; without it serve cannot protect stale UI edits. GUI-only /gui/* routes stay in td-gui.

post.summary: Register CLI or td serve session
post.description: Register CLI or td serve session
Empty request body. Only the caller session may heartbeat. Successful new operations update last_activity and project change token; retries replay without refreshing timestamps.

get.description: Default excludes closed and deleted, includes blocked/in_review. Complete fields unlike existing slim GUI list. All pages carry one change_token; Reader adapter must restart if tokens differ between pages. Stable tie breaker is id. search_mode=auto attempts TDQ and falls back to text only on invalid syntax/fields; tdq reports invalid queries; text searches literal ID/title/description/acceptance. Structured filters intersect with search before pagination. An explicit sort/order overrides TDQ sort; otherwise TDQ sort is preserved. with_deleted=true is for archive/restore only and includes deleted issue query facts.

get.description: Populate all TaskListDTO categories using td reviewpolicy and dependency queries for the requesting session. Return one consistent snapshot including focus, activity, handoffs, active sessions and token. TUI adapter converts DTO to RefreshDataMsg and resolves selected board separately.

put.description: null clears focus. Scoped by project and caller session, never a project global value.

get.summary: Stream refresh and ping SSE events
get.description: text/event-stream. id is change_token; event refresh data is RefreshEvent; ping data is PingEvent. Initial/reconnect refresh with current token when cursor differs; no durable delta replay. Client invalidates and refetches. Heartbeat every 15s. td serve relays as /v1/events to browser; fall back to changes polling on disconnect.

200.description: SSE stream; named refresh and ping events.

get.summary: Local project metadata and backend capabilities

revision.description: Opaque revision. Strong ETag is this value enclosed in double quotes.

IssueDTO.description: Complete store record; revision is opaque. Arrays are never null. Optional reviews require with=reviews. List responses retain description and acceptance for Reader compatibility.

ProjectID.description: Immutable server-generated prj_ + lowercase canonical UUIDv7 (RFC 9562). Never derived from project name, Git remote or local path. Generated once on project creation; retry with same Idempotency-Key returns the same ID. Treat as opaque and authorize every access.

OperationKey.description: Client-generated lowercase canonical UUIDv4. One key per command intent, including td init; persist and reuse exactly the same key/request for retries. Scoped by Actor and Project, or Actor + @server for project creation.

repository.description: Canonical repository identity, optional; never use an absolute local path as shared identity.

title.description: Trimmed Unicode rune count is validated against project limits, default 15..200.

due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or empty string to clear.

defer_until.description: YYYY-MM-DD or empty string to clear.

IssueCreate.description: Server assigns ID, timestamps, creator session and open status. Default type task, priority P2, points 0. Dependencies are created atomically.

title.description: Trimmed Unicode rune count is validated against project limits, default 15..200.

due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or empty string to clear.

defer_until.description: YYYY-MM-DD or empty string to clear.

IssuePatch.description: Omitted fields stay unchanged; null is rejected. Clear strings with "" and labels with []. Status, attribution and timestamps require dedicated actions. Substantive edits supersede active review atomically.

TransitionInput.description: reviewed_by and self_review=true are mutually exclusive. Self review requires a nonempty reason. Server checks project policy and authenticated actor privileges; force never bypasses review policy.

HandoffInput.description: Creates a handoff and, for an in_progress issue with submit_review=true, submits review in the same transaction.

ActivityInput.description: comment/log require nonempty message; log requires log_type. Attribution, IDs and timestamps are assigned by server. Passive append never submits review.

SessionCreate.description: Assigns a project-scoped session ID to the authenticated actor. Local process/worktree state stays on client. Session IDs are attribution, never proof of reviewer independence.

Operation.description: Durable receipt atomically committed with mutation. A GET 404 means no committed receipt was visible at that instant; an in-flight request may still commit.

Session.name: X-TD-Session
Session.description: Registered project session owned by authenticated actor. td serve supplies its own web session; browser never needs this header.

Operation.name: Idempotency-Key
Operation.description: Client generated UUIDv4, retained for project lifetime. Scoped by actor and project, fingerprint includes session, method, path, body and If-Match. Same key+request returns original committed response before revision checks; different request returns 409.

Revision.name: If-Match
Revision.description: Exactly one strong ETag for the aggregate being mutated. Wildcard and weak tags rejected. Missing 428, stale 412. Check and mutation are atomic.

Error400.description: Invalid JSON, field or TDQ; validation_error

Error403.description: Project access, builtin restriction or review policy; forbidden

Error404.description: Resource or receipt not found; not_found

Error409.description: Invalid workflow, relation cycle or idempotency fingerprint mismatch; conflict

BearerAuth.description: Existing td serve local bearer token, injected by td-gui reverse proxy. This token is distinct from backend credentials and never exposed to browser.
